statewide_source.name: NDGISHub Parcels
statewide_source.use: parcel ID (GISID) and shape only; its Ownership field is an ownership category (private, public, etc.), not owner names, and there is no deed field, so it is not an owner source

_meta.deed_formats: North Dakota recorders mostly index by document number, and very few county parcel layers carry a deed field. Only Oliver (Book / Page), Stark (DOCM_NUMBER) and Steele (DocNumber) have deed fields, and all three are empty or nearly empty. Deed references show up inside text instead: Williams legal descriptions end with '#623247' style document numbers (about 28,601 of 34,112 parcels), Grand Forks city copy legal text has '(DOC#732325)' (129 parcels), and Mountrail DEDS01 has 'BOOK 291 PAGE 123' (144 parcels). None of these are parsed or counted until the reviewer decides (ND questions 5 and 6).
_meta.plat_formats: Cass has PLATID; McKenzie has TXPLAT; McHenry has SubdivisionPlat (plat name). No plat book / page fields found.

status_legend.ok: county (or county vendor) layer with owner, PIN and a deed reference on at least half the parcels, covering the county
status_legend.partial: owner and PIN but deed field missing or thin, or a city or outside copy, or the layer may not cover the whole county
status_legend.missing: no owner layer with a live public ArcGIS endpoint
